title: cargo-allow policy revision note v1
description: Durable, append-only change-note record for governed weakening edits to the source-exception ledger. Design contract: CARGO-ALLOW-ADR-0002. Enforcement is deferred to GOAL-0004 PR 4; this schema fixes the record shape only.

created.description: ISO date the note was authored.

owner.description: Accountable owner for the governed weakening edit.

reason.description: Why the governed weakening edit is authorized.

status.description: Append-only lifecycle. A superseded note is replaced by a later note via supersedes/superseded_by.

allow_ids.description: Stable allow IDs covered by this note. Multiple IDs are allowed only when they share one logical edit (same reason and links).

change_kinds.description: Union of governed weakening change kinds across the covered entries.

after_fingerprints.description: Optional intended post-edit selector/snippet fingerprints (for example fnv1a64:<hash>) that anchor the note to one end state for diff matching.

links.description: References that justify the edit (issue:, pr:, doc:, adr:, spec:).

supersedes.description: Prior note this record corrects (append-only chain).

superseded_by.description: Later note that corrects this record.
